mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id, i.name, m.media_url, (m.media_id = mh.media_id) AS applied FROM user_inventory ui JOIN item i ON i.item_id = ui.item_id AND i.category = 'BGM' JOIN media m ON m.target_type = 'BGM' AND m.target_id = i.item_id JOIN minihompy mh ON mh.user_id = ui.user_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.item_id DESC
SELECT media_url FROM media WHERE target_type = 'BGM' AND target_id = #{itemId}
